0.headline: Paramotor Digital Technology, Pushp Brands receive SEBI approval to go ahead with IPO plans
0.heading: Paramotor Digital Technology, Pushp Brands receive SEBI approval to go ahead with IPO plans
0.intro: SEBI issued its observations on the draft papers of Paramotor Digital Technology on August 25 and those of Pushp Brands (India) on August 27.
0.body:
&nbsp;

Paramotor Digital Technology and Pushp Brands (India) have received approval from capital markets regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), clearing the way for the companies to move towards launching their initial public offerings (IPOs).

Paramotor Digital Technology, which operates a fintech and enterprise technology ecosystem serving consumers and businesses across India, filed its draft IPO papers with SEBI through the confidential route in May 2026. Packaged spices and food company Pushp Brands (India) also filed its IPO papers with the regulator in the same month.

SEBI issued its observations on the draft papers of Paramotor Digital Technology on August 25 and those of Pushp Brands (India) on August 27.

Under SEBI rules, companies that receive observations can launch their IPO within one year in the case of a regular filing. Companies that file their draft papers through the confidential route have 18 months to launch their public issue.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Paramotor Digital Technology

Founded in 2016, Paramotor Digital Technology provides consumer spend management, rewards and loyalty solutions, digital gifting and enterprise technology services.

Its portfolio includes SpendPro, a prepaid card-based spend management platform; RewardOn, an enterprise rewards and loyalty management solution; yayyy.shop, a direct-to-consumer digital gifting marketplace; and DevStack, its enterprise technology and software development services vertical.

Pushp Brands IPO

Madhya Pradesh-based Pushp Brands (India) is looking to raise funds entirely through an offer for sale (OFS), with no fresh issue component.

Its promoters, Mahendra Kumar Surana and Surendra Kumar Surana, along with investors A91 Emerging Fund I LLP and Sixth Sense Ventures, will sell 74.45 lakh shares through the OFS.

Founded in 1974 in Indore, Pushp Brands is a branded packaged spices and food company that claims to be among the leading spice brands in Madhya Pradesh, with a 20.7 percent market share in FY25.

Pushp Brands has appointed ICICI Securities, IIFL Capital Services and Systematix Corporate Services as merchant bankers to manage its IPO.

1.headline: Annu Projects IPO subscribed 88% on Day 3; check latest GMP
1.heading: Annu Projects IPO subscribed 88% on Day 3; check latest GMP
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firm Annu Projects remained subdued on the third day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 88 percent as of 5:00 pm on August 27, according to NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firm Annu Projects remained subdued on the third day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 88 percent as of 5:00 pm on August 27, according to NSE data.

The Rs 175.06-crore IPO received bids for 1,55,25,367 shares against 1,76,83,000 shares on offer. Qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) led the demand, with their portion subscribed 1.16 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) portion was subscribed 90 percent, while the retail investor portion saw 81 percent subscription.

The IPO will remain open for subscription until August 28. The company has fixed the price band at Rs 94-99 per share.

Read Also: Lumino Industries IPO subscribed 28% so far on opening day; GMP at 67%

Investors can bid for a minimum of 151 shares and in multiples thereafter. At the upper end of the price band, one lot requires an investment of Rs 14,949. Retail investors can apply for up to 13 lots, or 1,963 shares, requiring Rs 1,94,337 at the upper price band.

In the grey market, Annu Projects shares were commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 4, according to InvestorGain. At the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 99, the premium translates into a potential listing gain of 4 percent.

GMP is an unofficial and unregulated market indicator. It can change before the shares are listed and does not guarantee the actual listing price or returns.

Annu Projects is seeking to raise Rs 175.06 crore through an entirely fresh issue of 1,76,83,000 equity shares, with no offer-for-sale component. At the upper price band of Rs 99, the company will have a market capitalisation of about Rs 648.38 crore.

The company has reserved not more than 10 percent of the issue for qualified institutional buyers, at least 50 percent for retail investors and at least 40 percent for non-institutional investors.

Of the net IPO proceeds, around Rs 15.41 crore will be used to purchase machinery and equipment, while Rs 115 crore has been earmarked for working capital requirements. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

For FY26, the company reported a standalone net profit of Rs 33 crore and revenue of Rs 241.2 crore.

The company faces competition from listed peers including Likhitha Infrastructure, Bondada Engineering, EMS and Suyog Telematics.

Mefcom Capital Markets is the sole book-running lead manager to the issue, while Kfin Technologies is the registrar. The equity shares are proposed to be listed on both the NSE and BSE. The tentative listing date is September 2.

About Annu Projects

New Delhi-based Annu Projects provides EPC services for overhead and underground utilities infrastructure. Its operations span telecom infrastructure, sewerage infrastructure and gas pipeline projects.

2.headline: Tempsens shares likely to double on listing day on Friday; here's how you should trade its shares
2.heading: Tempsens shares likely to double on listing day on Friday; here's how you should trade its shares
2.intro: Analysts have advised investors who received allotments to hold the stock for the long term.
2.body:
Tempsens Instruments shares are likely to make a strong debut on the exchanges on Friday, with grey market trends indicating a potential listing gain of more than 100 percent.

According to platforms tracking grey market activity, the shares are commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of up to 102 percent. Investorgain quoted a GMP of Rs 305, indicating a listing gain of 101.67 percent. IPO Watch, meanwhile, quoted a GMP of 101 percent.

Given the high GMP for the mainboard issue, analysts have advised investors who received allotments to hold the stock for the long term.

Narendra Solanki, Head-Fundamental Research-Investment Services at Anand Rathi Shares and Stock Brokers, said the IPO is valued at an implied price-to-earnings (P/E) multiple of 35.4 times and an EV/EBITDA multiple of 25.6 times based on FY26 earnings at the upper price band, making the valuation fully priced.

However, the company's strong revenue growth, diversified portfolio and expanding global presence are expected to support a significant listing premium, he said.

Tempsens Instruments is a diversified industrial technology company with a presence across temperature sensing solutions, electrical heating solutions and specialised cables. These segments contributed 44.6 percent, 20.7 percent and 34.7 percent, respectively, to FY26 revenue.

The company has 15 manufacturing facilities across India and overseas markets and a customer base of more than 3,800 customers. Its low customer concentration, product diversification and international expansion support its business.

Its strategic acquisitions, investments in manufacturing capabilities and focus on advanced high-temperature solutions are expected to support long-term growth.

The Rs 650-crore initial public offering of Tempsens Instruments (India) was subscribed 184.07 times on the final day of bidding on Monday, driven by strong demand from investors.

The company earlier raised Rs 194.55 crore from anchor investors, including Temasek and SBI Mutual Fund.

The price band for the issue was fixed at Rs 285-300 per equity share.

Abhinav Tiwari, Research Analyst at Bonanza, said the outlook remains positive, provided the company successfully integrates its recent acquisitions and converts its expanded product portfolio into organic growth.

He said the company's low leverage provides balance-sheet flexibility for further expansion. Adjusted return on equity of around 20-23 percent also indicates that the core business remains healthy despite the reported decline in ROE.
